How It Works

Gather AI Prana. One platform across every facility in your network.

SEE

Vision captures a continuous picture of what's actually happening across your facilities. Cameras on your forklifts read inventory in motion and drones read inventory at rest, pulling 10+ data points per frame, not just what your systems record.

THINK

Sage reasons across what Vision sees and the systems you already run, surfacing what's drifting and what's at risk before problems compound. No dashboard to interpret.

ACT

Workflows route the right action to the right person in the right system, task already drafted. Nothing falls through the cracks, across one facility or the whole network.
